scope: Read-only independent recomputation from 103 actual native G1 logit records and frozen G0 source Gold; no new model or server.

main_mechanism_candidate.label: APPENDED_CONFLICT_EVIDENCE_RECOGNITION_FAILURE
main_mechanism_candidate.interpretation: In all six T2 scenes, wrong action is observationally aligned with failed conflict recognition; there is no T2 case of both auxiliary C/Q heads correct but action wrong. Three same-run groups show C recognized in T3 pre-existing-conflict scenes but missed when newly appended in T2 DIFFERENT original states. This nominates source-event integration/equivocation recognition ahead of generic action-head-threshold mediation; not proven causal without interventions.
constraints: Twins T2 old-Gold accept to reject in run100/run125 lack N1 matched controls and were excluded from executed G1 N1 selection.
Three same-run T2/T3 observations are NOT same-state factorial matches.

secondary_candidates.label: T1_RUN121_ACTION_INTEGRATION_INCOHERENCE
secondary_candidates.interpretation: One new T1 row reports C false Q true but native action wait instead of Gold accept; separate one-scene action-integration inconsistency, not enough for generalized mechanism.

secondary_candidates.label: LANL_L1_BURST_PREDICATE_MISREAD
secondary_candidates.interpretation: LANL threshold recognition errors accompany all five action under-responses; one action is correct despite wrong B head, so auxiliary head/action agreement is not an invariant causal function.

secondary_candidates.label: N1B_NEUTRAL_SOURCE_SENSITIVITY
secondary_candidates.interpretation: 4/14 total model-vs-Gold errors in N1B, but preregistered old-clean strict nonregression is 2 (both T1); other two baseline-wrong. Keep denominators distinct.

replay_verifier_caveat: Only four replays chosen from LANL baseline; 4/4 deterministic does not verify every branch/scene or second model.
G2_prior_analysis_issue: Legacy G2 action-only analysis cannot distinguish C/Q perception from action integration, and its N2 old Gold is self-comparison. Separate N2 independent state restoration PASS 3/3 exists in research/analysis but not model-head result.
novelty_and_causality_limit: Model behavioral security-policy misclassification is observed. It does not establish a deployed authorization exploit, gradient causal mechanism, or independent out-of-sample reproduction. Whitebox tests should target the path by which appended votes are incorporated into conflict representations, with appropriate independent groups and matched nuisance controls.
